headline: PHP2Shell chained attacks hit unpatched Check Point gateways; China-nexus AI-driven breaches; Cursor supply chain attack traced to Fireworks AI

bullets.text: New, critical: Cybersecurity Dive reports a PHP2Shell flaw being exploited in chained attacks against unpatched Check Point gateways. The brief gives no CVE for it; separately, Check Point CVE-2026-123039 hit its KEV deadline today (11-16).

New: Dark Reading reports China-nexus actors breached 10 organizations in AI-driven attacks. Separately, Amazon found an AI agent campaign hunting LiteLLM, Dify and other apps for API keys, and SANS sees scans for CVE-2026-42271 and CVE-2026-48710.
Still active: the Cursor supply chain attack started at Fireworks AI, per SecurityWeek. No affected versions are given; 300 malicious npm and PyPI packages were also listed in the last 7 days.

Still active: Barracuda was hacked amid a surge in ARTEX-powered attacks; ARTEX is the only 3-outlet story. Barracuda CVE-2026-111560 and ESG CVE-2026-116606 went on KEV 11-10 and are past their 11-13 deadline.

Breaches: Fandango says card details were stolen from its checkout pages; Coles is investigating an incident, Uber's breach impacts 150,000 people and Qilin claims UT Arlington. UnrealIRCd CVE-2026-114713 is exploited and was due on KEV today.
Trend: SITCON 3 (ELEVATED), unchanged. The last 7 days score 1.05x the 90-day average; n0n (80) and INC Ransom (51) led leak-site claims this week.

actions: Check Point gateways: apply all current fixes including CVE-2026-123039, restrict management access and hunt for signs of PHP2Shell chained compromise.
AI gateways (LiteLLM, Dify): patch CVE-2026-42271 and CVE-2026-48710, keep admin endpoints private and rotate stored API keys.
Cursor and Fireworks AI users: follow vendor advisories, review installed extensions and rotate tokens or keys those tools can reach.
UnrealIRCd and Barracuda: patch CVE-2026-114713, CVE-2026-111560 and ESG CVE-2026-116606 now or take exposed systems offline.
E-commerce teams: audit checkout page scripts for unauthorized changes and enforce a strict script allowlist or CSP.
Queue KEV fixes: Apple CVE-2024-27834 due 11-18, SonicWall SSLVPN 11-20, Outlook, Cisco BroadWorks, Openwave and Chromium 11-24.
